name: Dreamin'Halloween
original_name: ドリーミンハロウィーン
source:
The story is about our protagonist, an ancient human who doesn't care if she is called a witch. Living in an eternity where death does not exist, the meaning and enjoyment of life is increasingly vague. Her only job is to give candy to the three guardians of the gates of the magical world on Halloween, but it's only two weeks away. Will she be able to give them the candy they want?

[From [url=https://uraotome.com/50261]UraOtome[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位活过漫长岁月的人类，就算被人称作魔女，她也毫不在意。在没有死亡的永恒生命里，活着的意义与乐趣变得越来越模糊。她唯一的工作，是在万圣节给魔法世界大门的三位守护者送糖果。可距离万圣节已经只剩两周，她能送上他们想要的糖果吗？

[摘自[url=https://uraotome.com/50261]UraOtome[/url]]
